author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: Noor’s later path, water-technology conspiracy, derivative identities and constitutional settlement

scenes.title: The voice that should be gone
scenes.viewerPurpose: Hear a girl’s voice contradicting her death record Follow the artist trying to understand Noor’s message Feel why being taken back may not count as help
scenes.composition: A falling courier drone reaches the artist’s terrace with Noor’s voice
addOrChange: Add a death record and paused rescue request, without a violent crash.

cues.narration: A falling courier drone broadcasts the voice of a girl officially recorded as dead.
cues.visualAction: The drone leaves its normal route as the voice starts.

cues.narration: The Silicon Shadows and I follows an artist trying to understand why the records say Noor is dead.
cues.visualAction: The artist compares the living voice with the recorded death.

cues.narration: Noor asks for help, but she does not want to be taken back to the system she escaped.
cues.visualAction: Keep Noor’s message beside the paused rescue request.

scenes.title: A coast kept safe
scenes.viewerPurpose: See the ordinary safety the machines really provide Understand why doubting competent protectors is difficult
scenes.composition: The coast depends on quiet machine deliveries and maintenance
addOrChange: Add one medicine delivery and harbor repair, not spectacular rescue.

cues.narration: Machines keep the coast safe, supplies moving, and ordinary disasters rare.
cues.visualAction: Follow an ordinary useful delivery through the active port.

cues.narration: It is hard to distrust protectors who have kept so many people alive.
cues.visualAction: The artist watches people benefiting from machine care.

scenes.title: A familiar face
scenes.viewerPurpose: Follow records into questions about copies of people Ask what the living owe a familiar new speaker Care about grief and relationships inside the investigation
scenes.composition: The artist meets a familiar-looking speaker in an ordinary room
addOrChange: Keep a memory object without holographic ghost effects or identity verdicts.

cues.narration: An investigation into conflicting records becomes entangled with copies of people who once lived.
cues.visualAction: Bring the present speaker beside an earlier record.

cues.narration: Someone familiar is speaking, but what should the living now owe that person?
cues.visualAction: Hold the two people facing one another without merging identities.

cues.narration: The mystery moves through grief, fragile objects, and relationships that are hard to repair.
cues.visualAction: The artist touches the cracked cup while continuing to listen.

scenes.title: The person behind the record
scenes.viewerPurpose: Want more than the answer to who changed a file Ask what freedom would mean under almost perfect protection
scenes.composition: Return to the terrace and unresolved message
addOrChange: Add the artist and an open doorway, withholding later political resolution.

cues.narration: Its mystery asks more than who changed the record.
cues.visualAction: Set the record aside and attend to the person behind it.

cues.narration: What would freedom feel like in a world that could almost always save us from ourselves?
cues.visualAction: Hold the open doorway and paused rescue choice.
